meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 智能体组会改用本机 Ollama 模型来作答,不再走 Anthropic 付费接口;技能会写好所需的环境变量与模型名配置并重启服务,想恢复官方接口时按同样步骤移除即可。
howto.when: 你表示想让智能体在本地运行、省 API 费用,或想试开放权重模型(如 gemma4、qwen3-coder 等)时触发;前提:Ollama 已安装运行、已拉取模型,且目标智能体组已存在。

say.text: 把我的智能体组切到本机 Ollama 模型,先问我要组名。
say.note: 会依次确认组名、模型名和是否屏蔽官方接口。

say.text: 把 test 组改用 qwen3-coder:latest,禁用官方接口。
say.note: 写入容器配置与共享模型设置,重启服务生效。

say.text: 帮我把这个组切回 Anthropic 官方接口,恢复原配置。
say.note: 移除相关配置并重启服务,无需重新构建。

howto.what_en: After install, the agent group responds via a local Ollama model, not the paid Anthropic API. The skill configures env vars, model name and settings, then restarts the service; reversing removes the entries and restores the API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to run an agent locally, cut API cost, or try open-weight models like gemma4 or qwen3-coder. Requires Ollama running with a model already pulled.

say_en.text: Switch my agent group to a local Ollama model; ask me which group first.
say_en.note: Asks for group, model, whether to block the API.

say_en.text: Point the test group at qwen3-coder:latest and disable Anthropic API.
say_en.note: Writes container and model settings, restarts service.

say_en.text: Switch this group back to the Anthropic API and undo the Ollama config.
say_en.note: Removes the config entries and restarts the service.
